verses.text: Thank the LORD because he’s good. His faithful love lasts forever.
Let Israel say it now: his faithful love lasts forever.
Let the family of Aaron say it now: his faithful love lasts forever.
Let those who fear the LORD say it now: his faithful love lasts forever.
I was in trouble, so I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me and set me free.
The LORD is on my side. I won’t be scared. What can any human do to me?
The LORD is on my side, right there among the people who help me. So I’ll see victory over the people who hate me.
It’s better to run to the LORD for shelter than to put your trust in people.
It’s better to run to the LORD for shelter than to put your trust in rulers.
All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.
They surrounded me, yes, on every side. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.
They swarmed around me like bees. They burned out like thorns on fire. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.
You shoved me hard to knock me down, but the LORD helped me.
The LORD is my strength and my song. He’s become my rescue.
Listen to the cheers of joy and rescue in the tents of the righteous: “The LORD’s right hand has done mighty things!
The LORD’s right hand is lifted high! The LORD’s right hand has done mighty things!”
I’m going to live, not die, and tell what the LORD has done.
The LORD disciplined me hard, but he didn’t hand me over to death.
Open the gates of righteousness for me. I’ll go through them and thank the LORD.
This is the LORD’s gate. The righteous will go through it.
I’ll thank you because you answered me and became my rescue.
The stone the builders turned down has become the cornerstone.
The LORD did this, and it blows us away to see it.
This is the day the LORD has made. Let’s celebrate and be glad in it! 🙌
Please save us now, LORD! LORD, please make things go well for us now.
Blessed is the one who comes in the LORD’s name! We bless you from the LORD’s house.
The LORD is God, and he’s given us light. Tie the sacrifice with ropes, right up to the horns of the altar.
You’re my God, and I’ll thank you. You’re my God, and I’ll lift you high.
Thank the LORD because he’s good. His faithful love lasts forever.
